title: Localization embeds into generic fibre localizations
statement: Let $R\to B$ be a flat homomorphism of commutative rings of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Suppose $B\otimes_R K$ is a domain for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ and field extension $K/\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Let $\mathfrak q_{\mathfrak p}$ be the inverse image of the zero prime of $B\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$. With spectra and localization as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-module-localization], the natural map $$B\longrightarrow\prod_{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}R}B_{\mathfrak q_{\mathfrak p}}$$ is injective.
